title: Add HTML products list page to Go legacy-products handler
description: Brownfield Go task: add an HTML listing endpoint to the products monolithic handler using html/template with an inline template string.

task_spec.prompt:
Add an HTML-rendering handler for /products.html. All 4 existing tests must still pass. 1. Create internal/products/html.go with: func HTMLListProducts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) — GET only (405 for any other method) — Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 — page title and

: "Products" — renders all products in a with columns: ID, Name, Price — if store is empty: shows

No products found.

instead of a table — uses html/template with an inline template string (no external files) — reads store via the existing mu sync.Mutex and store slice 2. Add a case to the Handler switch in internal/products/products.go: case path == "/products.html": HTMLListProducts(w, r) Place this case BEFORE the strings.HasPrefix cases. All 4 existing tests must still pass. Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: GET /products.html returns 200 with text/html content type
HTMLListProducts shows product Name and Price in table
HTMLListProducts shows 'No products found.' when store is empty
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
